Name: Seasonal NPCs - SVE and RSV
Author: exklamationmark
Description:
[b][size=5]What it does[/size][/b]

If you want a stylized, anime-like look for the characters, with seasonal variations, this is the mod for you.
Plus, you should ONLY need this one mod to work with the original SV, SVE or SVE + RSV.

The portraits in anime-style, aligning with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Ohodavi's anime portraits mod[/url]﻿.
In fact, I will try to reuse most of his design for characters faces, hair, etc.
I will only add clothing, accessories, occasionally patching their body/hair when I need to show more skin/body parts.

Release schedule is one character every ~2-3 weeks.

[size=3][b]The background story[/b][/size]

At first, I wanted more variations to the anime portraits, similar to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Ohodavi[/url]﻿'s anime style, so I can play SV again after 1.6 patch.
I also want something to work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]RSV[/url].
However, finding a mod with the art style I want and is organized sanely was not possible.
Thus, I started making this for personal use.

I'm also learning the skills to make my own game, so this is a learning-to-draw project for me as well.

[b][Shameless plug][/b]

If you are looking to see the making of a wholesome, cozy game that is a cross between Stardew Valley, Animal Crossing, plus a bit of Rimworld/Dwarf Fortress, [url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61557795247673]please check out my on-going works.[/url]
